label: rm68090
title: display rm68090
description: Pushes frames or gui screen strips to an RM68090 (or ILI9325/9328) 8-bit parallel TFT shield on a classic ESP32. Defaults are a Wemos D1 R32 with the shield's RS, CS and RST rewired to GPIO 15, 33 and 32.

properties.name: frameFormat
properties.label: frame format
properties.help: Match the gui screen's frame format, or the framebuf format a function node draws in.

properties.name: palette
properties.label: palette (16 RGB565 hex values)
properties.help: The same default colors as display spi. gs2 uses the first 4, mono the first 2.

properties.name: colorOrder
properties.label: color order
properties.help: Switch if red and blue come out swapped.

properties.name: checkId
properties.label: check controller ID at start
properties.help: Reads the controller's ID and stops with a clear error if it isn't an RM68090 or ILI9325/9328. Turn off only if the read fails on a panel that otherwise works.

properties.name: rs
properties.label: LCD_RS pin
properties.help: On a D1 R32 the shield's RS lands on input-only GPIO 35: wire GPIO 15 to it.

properties.name: cs
properties.label: LCD_CS pin
properties.help: On a D1 R32 the shield's CS lands on input-only GPIO 34: wire GPIO 33 to it.

properties.name: rst
properties.label: LCD_RST pin (-1 = not wired)
properties.help: On a D1 R32 the shield's RST lands on input-only GPIO 36: wire GPIO 32 to it.
